1. The above financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee in its meeting held on November 07, 2026 and approved by the Board of Directors at the meeting held on November 07, 2026. Above meetings were held in physical presence and also through video conference.

2. The consolidated results of the group is presented separately by including the parent HBL Engineering Limited [Formerly known as HBL Power Systems Limited], its three [3] subsidiaries, three [3] associates and one [1] Joint venture as required.

3. The equity shares of Tonbo Imaging India Limited have been listed on main board of both the exchanges effective October 23, 2026. The impact on the investment on account of such listing will be reflected from next quarter's financial results onwards.

4. Exceptional items include compensation of Rs. 13.66 cr received from the Government of Telangana towards compulsory acquisition of a portion of the land owned by the Company.

5. EPS is calculated based on total comprehensive income which is attributable to equity shareholders.

6. Figures of the previous quarters / periods have been regrouped, wherever necessary.

7. The results shall also be available on website of the Company : http://hbl.in/investors; BSE: www.bseindia.com and NSE: www.nseindia.com
